name.zh: 7. 风险管控（技术/进度/合规）

intent.zh: 确认从立项起持续识别、量化并处置风险，设置缓冲与熔断机制
intent.en: Ensure risks are continuously identified, quantified, and mitigated from project kickoff with buffers and fail-safes in place.

questions.id: risk-是否建立项目风险台账-技术-供应-合规-资源-并对风险进行-impact-probability-量化

text.zh: 是否建立项目风险台账（技术/供应/合规/资源），并对风险进行 Impact×Probability 量化？
text.en: Do we maintain a project risk register (technical/supply/compliance/resources) with Impact × Probability quantification?

zh.1: 无项目风险台账，风险靠经验沟通。
zh.2: 有风险清单但未量化 Impact×Probability。
zh.3: 建立风险台账并量化 Impact×Probability，指定责任人。
zh.4: 风险状态定期更新，缓解计划执行可追溯。
zh.5: 风险台账与项目指标联动，支持预警与决策。

en.1: No project risk register; risks are shared informally.
en.2: Risk list exists but without Impact × Probability quantification.
en.3: Risk register exists with Impact × Probability scores and assigned owners.
en.4: Risk status updates are regular with traceable mitigation execution.
en.5: Risk register links to project metrics enabling warnings and decisions.

threshold: 重大风险均量化并指定责任人
All major risks are quantified with assigned owners

questions.id: risk-是否为关键风险建立-plan-b-c-替代方案-降级策略-二供切换-并有演练记录

text.zh: 是否为关键风险建立 Plan B/C（替代方案/降级策略/二供切换）并有演练记录？
text.en: Do critical risks have Plan B/C (alternatives/derating/second-source switch) with drill records?

zh.2: 有口头 Plan B/C，但无演练与记录。
zh.3: 关键风险制定 Plan B/C 并形成文档。
zh.4: 替代方案有演练与资源准备，切换标准明确。
zh.5: Plan B/C 与监控指标联动，可快速触发并复盘优化。

en.2: Plan B/C exists verbally without drills or records.
en.3: Plan B/C is documented for critical risks.
en.4: Alternatives have drills and resourcing with clear switch criteria.
en.5: Plan B/C ties into monitoring metrics, enabling rapid activation and retrospective improvement.

focus: 等效性验证覆盖功能/可靠性
ask: 二供验证包含哪些测试？
关键风险的应急方案有哪些？
threshold: 关键物料二供通过验证并备案
高风险均具备演练过的替代方案

focus: Equivalence validation covers functionality and reliability
ask: Which tests are included in second-source validation?
What contingency plans cover critical risks?
How are drills and resources documented?
threshold: Critical components pass second-source validation with records filed
All high-risk items have rehearsed alternative plans
